name: VR HOT
summary: Interactive PCVR physics-driven companion simulator supporting full 6DOF headset tracking, physics interaction, and modular rooms.
ranking_rationale: True interactive 6DOF PCVR positioning and fluid physics rather than static 180 video (trade-off: requires strong desktop GPU tethered/AirLinked to Quest or Index).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: True interactive 6DOF PCVR positioning and fluid physics rather than static 180 video
Intuitive radial VR hand menus require zero keyboard gymnastics inside the headset
Active dev updates adding animations & customization
cons: Requires strong desktop GPU tethered/AirLinked to Quest or Index
Physics ragdoll moments can glitch playfully under fast moves
